market: Global Surface Preparation Chemicals for Bonding Market
market_definition: Surface Preparation Chemicals for Bonding comprises cleaners, degreasers, etchants and chemical pretreatment products applied to substrates before adhesive bonding to remove contaminants or improve surface condition. By Product Type • Solvent Cleaners • Aqueous Cleaners • Degreasers • Etchants • Conversion Treatments By Substrate • Metal • Plastic • Glass • Composite By Chemistry • Water-Based • Solvent-Based • Acid / Alkaline • Specialty Formulations By Application • Bonding Preparation • Contamination Removal • Oxide Removal • Surface Activation By End Use • Automotive • Aerospace • Electronics • Construction • Industrial Manufacturing By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Adhesives, primers marketed primarily as adhesion promoters, general-purpose cleaning products without bonding preparation use and mechanical preparation equipment. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
